rules.question: At what moment does the Path Builder's timeline put a fill?
rules.owner: timeline_fill_ms in src/ui/preview_timeline.cpp, the end of the fill's span, which the Fills row, the strip and a list row's scroll to its fill all read
rules.decision: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-31-path-builder-redesign-3.md, SC-4b, a list row whose fill is off screen scrolls the timeline to it (bar question 5)

owner_lines.line_text: double timeline_fill_ms(const app::PreviewFill& fill) { return fill.span.end_ms; }
owner_lines.why: timeline_fill_ms: the one place the timeline reads where a fill sits

rules.note: Where the timeline puts a fill is the end of its span. The row reads the two files that place or find a fill on the timeline; a fill's span start is another moment (the highway's view of it) and does not match. pb_text.cpp reads the end of a span to count saved Star Power bars, a different question, so it is out of scope.
